summary: Iteration 67 - Frontend testing for guided audio and install features. TopNav Install button PASS. GuidedPracticeOverlay PASS (timer, play/pause, mute, exit buttons all working). PracticeTimer with autoNarrate PASS (shows 'Weaving long-form script...' status). GuidedAudioButton PASS (shows 'Preparing audio...' then 'Stop Audio' states). InstallPrompt not visible (may be dismissed or already installed). TTS audio preparation takes 15-20+ seconds which may appear as 'no audible guidance' to users.

minor.issue: TTS audio generation takes 15-20+ seconds, causing 'Preparing your guide...' to show for extended period

integration_issues.issue: TTS audio preparation takes 15-20+ seconds. Users may perceive this as 'no audible guidance' since the script text is visible but audio hasn't started yet.

action_items: Consider adding a more prominent 'Audio loading...' indicator with estimated time
Consider pre-fetching TTS audio for the first segment while script is expanding
Verify TTS API response times are acceptable (currently 15-20+ seconds)
critical_code_review_comments: GuidedPracticeOverlay.jsx: The TTS loading flow is correct but the 'Preparing your guide...' status may not be clear enough to users that audio is coming
PracticeTimer.jsx: The 'Weaving long-form script...' status is shown correctly when autoNarrate is enabled
GuidedAudioButton.jsx: The button states (Listen/Preparing/Stop) are working correctly
